text:
Sam: Heads-up — Spectra Health wants a final POC run tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Need runbook, quick cost memo for procurement, and security blurb for the SQ. @Taylor @Anika please confirm infra and test payloads.

Taylor: Got it. I propose phased tests: warmup (2m), steady-state (20m), and burst window (90s). Warmup for JVM/gen caches, steady at target QPS, burst to 2.2k r/s. Need model/seq from product.

Anika: Product said clinical-summary workload, median prompt ~380 tokens + gen ~160. Use model=redwood-small-70B-q4f16. Will set max_tokens=160, temp=0.1, top_p=0.95.

Sam: Target steady QPS=750 r/s, burst 2.2k r/s. Customer SLO: p95 < 350ms. Procurement wants two pricing rows: continuous baseline and burst-enabled plan.

Taylor: Runbook notes (draft):
- Dedicated pool: 5xA100-80GB (redwood.dedicated.x5)
- workers/node = 6
- concurrency/worker = 12
- batching latency cap = 10ms
- KV prefix caching enabled (size env REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=48GB)
- gateway timeout 6s

Anika: Test payload details: 18 prompt templates + 4 deterministic probes. Average sequence ~540 tokens total. Will rotate templates to simulate variety.

Sam: Load driver: wrk2 with lua script for payload rotation. Example command:
```
wrk -t10 -c1400 -d00:20:00 --script=templates.lua http://staging.redwood/spectra/v1/generate
```
templates.lua will POST and include Authorization header.

Taylor: Quick vegeta sanity check before main run:
```
echo "POST http://staging.redwood/spectra/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=750 -duration=2m | vegeta report
```

Ryan: Security checklist: they asked for SOC2 Evidence, KMS key flow, and HSM provider details. I have SOC2 URL. Need infra note on key split for PII and logs. Also they prefer KMS rotation policy.

Anika: Perf knobs during run if latency climbs: shrink batching window to 6ms, disable some non-critical plugins, and temporarily reduce max_tokens to 96 for burst.

Taylor: Cost roughs: sustained 20m at 750 r/s -> ~1.4M tokens -> estimated 3.2 GPU-hours total -> ~$260 at reserved pool rates. 24/7 baseline at 750 r/s -> ~77 GPU-hours/day -> ~$6.2k/day. Add POC eng support fee $3,500 one-time. I'll put numbers in a simple table for procurement.

Sam: Ops: monitor cache_hit_ratio, p95, queue_length, and gate_forwarding_drops. Alert threshold: p95 > 380ms or queue_length > 800.

load-bot: warmup-started 1745610500 - bringing 5 nodes online

load-bot: warmup-complete 1745610620 - steady mean 170ms p95 260ms throughput 760 r/s

Taylor: Warmup looks clean. Proceeding to steady-state run for 20m.

load-bot: steady-run-complete 1745611820 - mean 220ms p95 330ms p99 610ms throughput 754 r/s KV_hit=69%

Anika: KV hit at 69% — below ideal. Increase REDWOOD_KV_CACHE to 64GB and enable persistent prefix hashing before burst.

Ryan: Security reply draft for SQ: 'KMS keys are customer-isolated via per-tenant CMKs, rotation every 90 days, HSM backed by AWS CloudHSM; logs are encrypted with separate envelope keys. We will attach SOC2 link and a simple KMS flow diagram.' Will add to appendix.

Sam: Proceed to burst window in 8 minutes. Remember to watch gateway CPU and frontend queue metrics.

load-bot: burst-run-started 1745612380 - escalating load to 2.2k r/s

load-bot: burst-run-complete 1745612480 - peak throughput 2.18k r/s, mean latency 560ms, p95 1.05s, p99 2.4s. Observed gateway queuing and ~30% request retries upstream.

Anika: Observed failure mode: gateway queueing at ~1.7k r/s. Suggest two mitigations: increase frontend replicas (x2) or rate-limit burst to protect model pool. Also turning off prefix de-dup during burst improved tail slightly.

Taylor: Notes for sales: steady-state meets SLO (p95 330ms < 350ms). Burst exceeds SLO; with mitigations (frontend autoscale + reduced max_tokens) we can bring p95 under 500ms for short windows. Recommend offering 'burst add-on' for customers needing >1.6k sustained.

Ryan: I'll attach Security appendix + SOC2 link and include KMS blurb. Also will reply to procurement about HSM vendor.

Sam: Action items: Taylor finalize runbook + cost memo, Anika attach raw CSV metrics, Ryan finalize SQ appendix. I'll bundle everything in the deal thread and include suggested contract language for burst add-on. Thanks all :thumbsup:
